$comment: vcpkg manifest for the libssh2 native dependency (OpenSSL crypto backend, zlib disabled - libgit2 bundles its own zlib). openssl is pinned here too because it is libssh2's build-time dependency; libssh2 links libcrypto-3-x64.dll by name and stays ABI-compatible across the whole OpenSSL 3.x series, so it only needs rebuilding on an OpenSSL MAJOR bump. Kept in lock-step with the libssh2 git submodule tag.
name: libgit2-native-deps-libssh2
